cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Agree to the Exact Words
cards.instruction: Agree to the exact wording, then use later callbacks to narrow what those words can obligate you to do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll organise this load. I agreed to carry one box to the van.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You promised to help me move.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: With one box. You choose it and I'll take it out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fine. Lift it into my arms. I agreed to carry it; you can handle getting it off the floor.

reason: Make A accommodate the larger box while using the exact carry promise to assign the initial lift to B; leadership now depends on B physical cooperation.
